DF-07.title: Source-supply / search-provider sensitivity
DF-07.statement: SS-GP94 is a 1994 publication squarely on S6's frozen disputed component, well inside the evidence cutoff, and decisive for S6. The frozen SR-B2 v2 query battery never returned it across all 16 prescribed invocations on the available search provider. S6's original verdict (OPEN) and its supplied verdict (READY) differ for reasons of retrieval design and provider coverage, not the state of the literature.
DF-07.classification: Defect of the retrieval procedure. Recorded against the procedure, not absorbed into any target verdict.
DF-07.confirms: RD-01 concretely: SOURCE-FAIL or OPEN under SR-B2 v2 measures the bounded retrieval design, never the scholarly record.
